name: labs/mfg92__hantek1008py
title: Hantek 1008C USB oscilloscope (hantek1008.Hantek1008)
intro: Hantek 1008C USB oscilloscope (hantek1008.Hantek1008), adapted from mfg92/hantek1008py. It reads `active_channels`, `vertical_scales`, `zero_offsets`, `paused` and 1 more; runs `set_generator_on`, `set_generator_speed`, `set_generator_waveform`, `set_paused` and 1 more. `set_generator_on`: enable or disable the eight digital waveform-generator outputs. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/mfg92__hantek1008py --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/mfg92__hantek1008py --backend fake --mcp
